content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IARI Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), New Delhi for a contractual research position under the DST Widushi Scheme.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available position is Research Assistant. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under this particular recruitment notification for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Assistant position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000 along with 27% House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per institutional guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a minimum qualification of B.Sc in Agriculture, Life Sciences, or Zoology with a specialization in Entomology from a recognized university or college.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 50 years. Age relaxations for reserved categories like SC, ST, OBC, PH, and Ex-Servicemen are applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in. Candidates do not need to submit any online or offline applications beforehand; they can directly attend the interview.

faq.question: Q7. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on October 23rd, 2026. Candidates must report at the designated venue on time with all required paperwork.

faq.question: Q8. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Division of Entomology, ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi - 110012. Candidates should arrive well in advance.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to bring the application form in the specified proforma, original educational and identity documents, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this IARI job opening?
faq.answer: The selection process entirely consists of a Walk-in Interview followed by the rigorous verification of all original supporting documents submitted by the candidates.
